title: Global data plans. Zero physical SIM cards.
subtitle: Land in any country and connect to high-speed internet instantly without expensive roaming fees.

features.title: Instant Activation in 180+ Destinations
features.desc: No more searching for local SIM kiosks at airport arrivals. Getly lets you browse regional data packages, install via QR code, and connect the moment your flight lands.
features.item1: Instant QR code or 1-tap in-app profile installation
features.item2: Flexible local, regional, and global data bundles
features.item3: Zero roaming bill surprises when traveling abroad

faq.title: eSIM FAQs
faq.q1: Is my smartphone compatible with Getly eSIM?
faq.a1: Most modern smartphones from Apple, Google, and Samsung support eSIM technology. You can check compatibility instantly in the app.
faq.q2: Do I lose my primary phone number when using Getly eSIM?
faq.a2: No. Your eSIM operates alongside your physical SIM, allowing you to keep your primary number active for WhatsApp and messages.
